svg.text: THIS module: case, its own drawers / wheels, and scheduled doors.
Images show actual saved model geometry; exploded views are identification aids.
1. Build this bay frame, rear brace and Top. Keep the wheel path open to the floor.
2. Fit the short guides and plywood L grip inside the solid outside panels.
3. Build THIS module's drawer: sides, Bottom, Back, then square Front.
4. Attach four wheel plates directly beneath Bottom; NO plywood mounting pads.
5. Trial-fit drawer and retention strap; test its direction and travel before joining bays.
